study.question: Can the buy head, the remaining auxiliary owner of shared context gradients, lose residual and/or tower capacity while preserving the current click AUC and lowering measured prediction cost?
study.hypothesis: Observed private-head reductions preserved click AUC exactly once their upstream paths were detached, while reducing which task kept capacity changed click AUC. That structural isolation does not establish removable capacity in the active buy path. The buy residual (10 channels) and tower ([112,64]) may contain redundant capacity, so reducing them separately or jointly may preserve the quality of the shared context updates. This is unverified; no exact click parity is predicted. Earlier all-auxiliary residual6 and broad scorer/embedding failures make a bounded, conditional factorial more informative than another private-head or dead-work variation.

nearest_work.difference: Closest executed source, inspected in full: same modules and forward. Only buy residual override 6 and/or buy tower override [96,48] change; prior private-head reductions and coefficient execution changes do not isolate this remaining active context path.

All these inherited concepts remain. This is a local width-allocation study of an adapted four-task compressed model, not a new attention mechanism or an exact original DIN reproduction.

study.proposed_difference: A 2x2 capacity factorial on buy only: residual hidden 10 vs 6 and tower [112,64] vs [96,48]. Reference is byte-identical to g2-r0046-joint_coefficient_reference. All cells use standalone modules with the same executable AST outside literal CONFIG. No loss, information, history, gradient ownership or host recipe changes. Analytical savings are 4304 residual parameters and 9040 tower parameters; measured utility remains open.
predictions: Primary predeclared screening gate: candidate click AUC >= contemporaneous reference AUC - 0.0002 AND >= 0.666553547526167 (frozen entry 0.666753547526167 - 0.0002). At exact reference replication 0.6671669182126774 the stronger threshold is 0.6669669182126774. This tolerance is an operational criterion, not a statistical equivalence claim.

Directional prediction: one or both single reductions preserve the click gate with fewer dense parameters; combined removal may interact because both influence the same buy context update. No guaranteed preservation is assumed.

Cost gate: strictly fewer measured parameters plus at least 2% lower model-only p50 batch inference latency versus the same-round reference at batch8192; report p95, throughput, total inference and training seconds, peak memory separately. Single-pass timing is screening only; require repeated matched timings before an efficiency claim.

Report all four AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean and inherited history slices with samples/positive/negative counts. Flag any per-task AUC loss >0.005 versus reference as an auxiliary degradation; it cannot be presented as a four-task Pareto improvement. No per-slice winner selection.
falsifiers: A candidate fails utility if it misses either click threshold, has no actual parameter reduction, or misses the prediction-cost gate; training speed alone is insufficient.

A loss >0.0002 in an isolated cell counters the proposed redundancy at that stage, conditional on this seed/template/training exposure. Reproducible loss across paired seeds is stronger counterevidence.
If the factorial combined loss departs materially from the single changes, independent/additive redundancy is unsupported; paired seed variation is needed before an interaction claim.

Any masked-input dependence, nonfinite output/loss/gradient, altered shared initialization/RNG, unexpected module ownership or host-contract failure invalidates the comparison, independently of scientific performance.

observation_review.observation: DIN click AUC0.6555441 vs imported joint0.6667535, but DIN auxiliary AUCs are much higher. These are quality/cost utility references, not a mechanism-isolating pair.
Broad reductions lost click quality relative to their parents. All-aux residual6 produced0.6669390 vs parent0.6671249; it did not isolate buy at the current ownership/widths.

Click0.6671669182 was unchanged across private allocation/init changes while cart/fav quality changed. Upstream detach structurally explains isolation, subject to dense clipping; no seed-independent mechanism claim. Private cart/fav AUCs around0.677/0.674 are material negative outcomes.

All four task metrics match, but p50 timings14.9841/14.8540/14.9598ms and total inference25.9556/24.7737/25.4854s vary. This does not establish repeatable savings or additivity; the next study retains the unchanged reference execution.
